title: Token Bucket Rate Limiter
description: Implement a deterministic Token Bucket Rate Limiter class `TokenBucketRateLimiter` that controls request throughput using an explicit `now: float` timestamp parameter (in seconds). The bucket starts full at `capacity` tokens and refills continuously at `refill_rate` tokens per second up to `capacity`.
entry_points: def __init__(self, capacity: float, refill_rate: float, initial_time: float = 0.0) -> None:
def allow_request(self, tokens: float = 1.0, now: float = 0.0) -> bool:
edge_cases: Raise ValueError if capacity <= 0 or refill_rate <= 0 in __init__
Raise ValueError if tokens <= 0 in allow_request
Clamp available tokens so they never exceed capacity even after long idle periods
If `now` is earlier than the last recorded timestamp, do not subtract tokens (treat elapsed time as 0.0)

constraints.time_complexity: O(1) per allow_request and available_tokens call
constraints.space_complexity: O(1) state storage per limiter instance

acceptance_tests.description: Bucket starts full and consumes tokens accurately without refill at same timestamp.
acceptance_tests.test_code:
def test_initial_capacity_and_consumption():
    limiter = TokenBucketRateLimiter(capacity=5.0, refill_rate=1.0, initial_time=10.0)
    assert math.isclose(limiter.available_tokens(now=10.0), 5.0)
    assert limiter.allow_request(tokens=3.0, now=10.0) is True
    assert math.isclose(limiter.available_tokens(now=10.0), 2.0)
    assert limiter.allow_request(tokens=3.0, now=10.0) is False
    assert math.isclose(limiter.available_tokens(now=10.0), 2.0)

acceptance_tests.description: Bucket refills proportionally to elapsed time and caps at capacity.
acceptance_tests.test_code:
def test_continuous_refill_and_cap():
    limiter = TokenBucketRateLimiter(capacity=10.0, refill_rate=2.0, initial_time=0.0)
    assert limiter.allow_request(tokens=8.0, now=0.0) is True
    assert math.isclose(limiter.available_tokens(now=2.5), 7.0)
    assert math.isclose(limiter.available_tokens(now=100.0), 10.0)
    assert limiter.allow_request(tokens=10.0, now=100.0) is True

acceptance_tests.description: Invalid capacity, refill_rate, or requested token count must raise ValueError.
acceptance_tests.test_code:
def test_invalid_parameters_raise_value_error():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        TokenBucketRateLimiter(capacity=0.0, refill_rate=1.0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        TokenBucketRateLimiter(capacity=5.0, refill_rate=-2.0)
    limiter = TokenBucketRateLimiter(capacity=5.0, refill_rate=1.0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        limiter.allow_request(tokens=0.0, now=1.0)
